limitations: Proposed bridges and approaches are not engineered or legally approved; decks have no slope/ramp penalty except the LIC–Midtown island exit.
Origin and bridge-end access connectors are assumed straight links, not verified public paths.
LION centerlines approximate walking; crossings, sidewalks, signals, barriers and access hours are incomplete.
Private streets and uncertain feature/status codes are excluded; no spatial-intersection auto-connections.
Constant speed ignores slope, bridge clearance, ramps, stairs, elevators and crossing delays.
No transit, cycling, vehicle, congestion, step-free or financial effects modeled.
Display polygons are buffered reachable street corridors, not all reachable land or opportunity counts.
All-city source graph prevents artificial clipping at the pilot or community-district boundary.

provenance.geometry_policy: Saved geometry rounded to 7 decimals for display; trimming uses projected fractions.
